name: Camp Agawam
description_short: An overnight summer camp for boys in Raymond, Maine, with 7-week and 3.5-week sessions and a Senior Club leadership program for former campers. Tuition covers meals, weekly laundry and most activities.
activities: Trips to Acadia, Allagash (canoe), Rangeley Lakes, Mt. Katahdin, Mt. Washington and Moosehead
refund_policy_summary: $2,000 deposit is non-refundable if enrollment is cancelled after January 1. If a camper leaves during the summer by mutual agreement with the director for health or adjustment reasons, tuition is refunded pro rata. No refund if he leaves by his own choice or for breaking camp rules. Unspent money in the $300 personal account is refunded.
